object.name: evi.gaussiannoise~
object.description: An approximate 'Box-Muller' gaussian noise distribution. It looks roughly the same as white noise in a spectral view, slightly different in a <o>scope~</o>. In a histogram one can see the distribution. The point is the gaussian random number distribution (see the helpfile for details).
object.discussion: Note that in a normal distribution the gaussian outlet (outlet 1) should give output in the range approximately -HALFPI..HALFPI. However, because of the approximations used here, the given output is approximately in the range -1.11..1.11. In the 'evi_approx.genexpr' source file this is NOT accounted for, but in this 'evi_gaussiannoise' / 'evi.gaussiannoise~' abstraction it is accounted for so that, like the other outputs, gaussian noise outputs in range -1..1
